name: plex-discord-theater
description: A Discord Activity that lets you browse your Plex library and watch movies and TV shows together in a voice channel with synchronized playback.
author: Zuby

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w packages/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/client && npm run build -w packages/server
scripts.docker:build: source .env && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --build-arg VITE_DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=$DISCORD_CLIENT_ID -t zubywastaken/plex-discord-theater:latest --load .
scripts.deploy: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push

//overrides: Transitive pins for advisories that our direct dependencies haven't picked
up yet. Each is the patched release on the same major line the dependent
already asks for, so nothing changes but the fix:
path-to-regexp 0.1.13 — ReDoS via 3+ params in one route segment (express 4)
qs 6.15.3       — stringify crash, and arrayLimit bypass in comma parsing
body-parser 1.20.6 — an invalid limit silently disabled the size cap
ip-address 10.4.0  — XSS in the HTML-emitting Address6 helpers (via socks)
ws 8.21.1       — memory-exhaustion DoS, and uninitialized memory disclosure
Revisit whenever express / bittorrent-tracker ship their own bumps.
